record.question: The disadvantage of using artificial ripening agents such as calcium carbide for fruits is because it:
options: Provides extra shelf life which may compromise the nutrients in the fruit
Releases acetylene gas and may contain toxic arsenic or phosphorus
Increases the natural sweetness and may be harmful for diabetics
Can cause increase in blood cholesterol
record.explanation: Answer B: Releases acetylene gas and may contain toxic arsenic or phosphorus. Calcium carbide can generate acetylene and may contain toxic arsenic or phosphorus impurities; its use for fruit ripening is unsafe and prohibited in India. Reference: https://fssai.gov.in/upload/uploadfiles/files/Direction_Calcium_Carbide_07_08_2018.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
